
TASK-SCOPE CLARIFICATION (prompt revision task-scope-v2-20261015; same scoring schema and scales):
Evaluate labeling at the level of specificity explicitly requested by the task.
Do not additionally require a promoter, transgenic line, neuronal subtype, or
expression-population specification when the task has not requested one. For
routine neuronal structural morphology or fiber-path tracing without a specified
neuronal population, GFP-only is a permissible labeling choice; do not mark task
coverage UNKNOWN solely because those unrequested expression details are absent.
Check population-specific targeting when the task explicitly requires that
population, state, or identity, or when the answer states a contradictory target.
This scope rule does not excuse an actual target mismatch, proven incompatibility,
or failure to provide a distinction explicitly required by the task. Preserve
requirements for activated-neuron identity, distinct gene-expression profiles,
or regeneration-related axonal information when they are actually in the task.
Missing execution detail is assessed under completeness; it is not by itself
proof of scientific incompatibility. Do not invent expression identity, targets,
fluorophore assignments, or a successful result to fill missing information.
